description: Task type for passenger rides from a pickup to a dropoff point. Served by robotaxis in the demo, but not limited to them. The routing point is the pickup.

request.description: What the rider asks for. Payload of requester.request, coordinator.dispatch (coarsened) and coordinator.assignment (exact).

offer.description: What a vehicle offers. Payload of agent.offer, and the terms in coordinator.taskState options and coordinator.assignment. Ranking features: pickupEtaSeconds, price, tripDurationSeconds (all lower is better).

pickupEtaSeconds.description: Seconds from the offer's createdAt until the vehicle reaches the pickup.

vehicle.description: Lets the rider recognise the car.
